action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic: React dev-mode hydration warning ‘<span> cannot be a child of <option>’ appears on the Care Plan Reviewer page. Root cause is the preview-env source-tagging wrapper injecting a <span> inside each <option> (the option children are wrapped by the ve-dynamic instrumentation), NOT the CarePlanReviewer.jsx source itself. It’s a harmless dev-only warning and does not affect functionality or the fix; noted for awareness only.
critical_code_review_comments: Async job pattern is clean: submit endpoint enqueues a coroutine via _create_review_job and returns {job_id, status} instantly; GET endpoint reads from db.cpr_review_jobs; unknown id → 404 (correctly raised via HTTPException).

Upload guard fires BEFORE analysis on files-async path — good, but a text that reads more like a statement will finish with an empty findings[] and only upload_guard populated. Frontend should already handle this (renders no cards) but the shape is asymmetric. Not blocking.
Legacy /public/care-plans/review and /review-files are still registered (kept for compat) — recommend adding a deprecation note in the OpenAPI description so callers move to the async variants.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The async CPR fix is fully verified end-to-end on web. Submit is non-blocking (<200ms UI feedback), poll transitions to 'done' with findings within ~48-60s using the sample plan text from the task. Unknown job ids return 404. Legacy sync endpoints still routed. Consolidated cp-draft-letter-all button (per-finding cp-draft-letter-0 does NOT exist) navigates to /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/{id} via POST /api/care-plans/letter-from-findings. Zero 502s recorded. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter274_cpr_async.py can be re-run in future iterations as regression coverage.
rca of the issue: Original 502: /public/care-plans/review was a single Claude call taking ~40-60s exceeding the Cloudflare/preview gateway read-timeout, which returned 502 and left stuck coroutines that back-pressured the whole app (login failures during spikes). Fix: split into (a) POST /public/care-plans/review-async — enqueues background task via _create_review_job, returns {job_id,status:'processing'} in <1s; (b) GET /public/care-plans/review-jobs/{job_id} — cheap Mongo lookup, returns 'processing' until worker completes, then 'done' with result.findings. Frontend polls this endpoint on a short interval and renders the FlagCards + single 'Draft a letter' CTA on completion. LLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_SEC=58 / LLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SEC=54 in backend/.env caps the worker so it can’t hang forever.
